pages.title: Copper Solar Panel
pages.text: Tier 1 solar panel. Generates 4 FE/t with 20,000 FE capacity. Basic early-game energy generation.

pages.title: Silicon Solar Panel
pages.text: Tier 2 solar panel. Generates 12 FE/t with 60,000 FE capacity. Improved efficiency.

pages.title: Reinforced Solar Panel
pages.text: Tier 3 solar panel. Generates 32 FE/t with 160,000 FE capacity. Mid-tier energy generation.
